name: Български празници — пълен каталог (всички категории), 3 езика (1991–2030)
title: Български празници — пълен каталог (всички категории), 3 езика (1991–2030)
description: Comprehensive Bulgarian holidays catalogue spanning 1991–2030, generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) canonical-pin commit 8086e609834c07df3f6179f05d864381ecba3453 (holidays==0.96). This pass-282 extension adds the HALF_DAY (Christmas Eve as half-day 1991–1995 per Labor Code Issue 104, 17.12.1991) and SCHOOL (Ден на народните будители / Day of the People's Awakeners, Nov 1, since 1992 per Labor Code Issue 88, 30.10.1992) categories on top of the previous public-only extraction. Multilingual names in Bulgarian (bg, native), English (en_US) and Ukrainian (uk) — all three supported_languages of the vacanza Bulgaria class. Each record carries the Gregorian date, multilingual weekday and holiday names, the category marker (public|half_day|school), and a national-scope flag.

meta.title: Български празници — пълен каталог (всички категории), 3 езика (1991–2030) - Безплатно изтегляне
meta.description: Comprehensive Bulgarian holidays catalogue spanning 1991–2030, generated from the vacanza/holidays Python library (MIT) canonical-pin commit 8086e609834c07df3f6179f05d864381ecba3453 (holidays==0.96). This pass-282 extension adds the HALF_DAY (Christmas Eve as half-day 1991–1995 per Labor Code Issue 104, 17.12.1991) and SCHOOL (Ден на народните будители / Day of the People's Awakeners, Nov 1, since 1992 per Labor Code Issue 88, 30.10.1992) categories on top of the previous public-only extraction. Multilingual names in Bulgarian (bg, native), English (en_US) and Ukrainian (uk) — all three supported_languages of the vacanza Bulgaria class. Each record carries the Gregorian date, multilingual weekday and holiday names, the category marker (public|half_day|school), and a national-scope flag. Съдържа 618 записа. Изтеглете в Excel, CSV, PDF формат.
